## Summary

Describe what this PR changes and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] refactor: code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] test: adds/updates tests
- [ ] chore: build/tooling/maintenance
- [ ] BREAKING CHANGE

## Release Notes Input

Use Conventional Commit style in the PR title when possible:

- feat: ... -> minor version bump
- fix: ... -> patch version bump
- feat!: ... or BREAKING CHANGE -> major version bump

Suggested release note (1-3 lines):

<!-- Add a short, user-facing summary for CHANGELOG/GitHub Release notes -->

## Validation

- [ ] npm run lint
- [ ] npm run test
- [ ] npm run build
- [ ] Relevant visual/perf checks run when applicable

## Scope and Risk

- [ ] Backward compatible
- [ ] Requires migration/config changes
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes included

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated for changed behavior
- [ ] Documentation updated (README/How-To/Guides) if needed
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] Screenshots included for UI changes (if relevant)
